newsitem.title: CANADA: Anvil Range closes share issue with Cominco.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Range closes share issue with Cominco.

text.p: Anvil Range Mining Corp said on Thursday that it closed its private placement of 4.1 million shares with Cominco Ltd.
The shares were placed for C$2.30 each for C$9.4 million, Anvil Range said in a statement.

With the issue of new shares, Anvil Range had 20.5 million shares outstanding, with 28 percent owned by Cominco and 20 percent by Hyundai Corp. Hyundai was Anvil's biggest shareholder before the issue.
The deal had been threatened by Mineral Resources Corp, which said last month it was planning a share-based takeover bid for Anvil Range.

Mineral Resources tried to pursuade Hyundai to oppose the transaction with Cominco. When its attempt failed, Mineral Resources withdrew its proposal to buy Anvil Range and withdrew its opposition to the Cominco plan.

Anvil Range had said it favored a deal with Cominco because the share issue would inject needed cash into Anvil, boosting the chances of the company's reopening its Faro zinc and lead mine in Canada's Yukon.
